info.title: FinOps Studio — Deterministic Banking, Payroll, Treasury & E-Invoicing Cloud APIs
info.summary: Zero-hallucination REST APIs for SEPA XML (pain.001/008), Peppol/XRechnung/Factur-X EN 16931 E-Invoices, US NACHA ACH, BAI2 Statements, German DATEV EXTF, UK BACS Standard 18, Australian ABA, Canadian CPA-005 & ISO 20022 pain.002.
info.description: Production financial file generation and statement parsing endpoints hosted on Apify Cloud ($0/month subscription, $0.02-$0.05 per row/invoice, $5/month free starter credits included). Compatible with OpenAI GPT Actions, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Postman, Retool, n8n, Make.com, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
